description: Symbols the HTML reference checks (plan DIG-7): searching `query` (default: name) must give the symbol's page as the first result, with the symbol's heading as its best sub-result where the page has one; and the old single-page anchor of the symbol (if it had one) must land on it. `accepted` names why a sample may miss the first place (it is still reported, with its rank). Generator-neutral: each generator maps a sample to its own URL.

samples.name: Player
samples.accepted: Pagefind matches the last query word as a prefix too, and its meta boost does not prefer the whole word: PlayerInputs, PlayerGhost and PlayerSlot rank first; Player is 4th

samples.name: THEME
samples.accepted: Pagefind matches the last query word as a prefix too, and its meta boost does not prefer the whole word (THEME_OVERRIDE); THEME is 3rd

samples.name: state
samples.accepted: Pagefind matches the last query word as a prefix too, and its meta boost does not prefer the whole word: StateMemory, the type of state, ranks first; the global is 2nd

samples.name: players
samples.accepted: Pagefind stems players to player, so every Player* type matches as well (see Player); the global is 11th
